name: 10591 · Tarrytown, NY
findings: ZIP 10591 (Tarrytown) has 155 nonprofit organizations. 76 of them (49%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 63 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (14% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 10591 (Tarrytown) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
42% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 10591 (Tarrytown) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 4.0 times the typical level).
